The '''[[Dark Council]] chamber''' on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. The chamber itself was an identical copy of the chamber used on Dromund Kaas during the reign of Empress Acina<ref name="kotet2">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=2}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Council chamber is only seen during the Onslaught expansion playthrough if the player's base class is Imperial.

Despite the Dark Council being reduced to 5 seats<ref name="reformed_council">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Reformed Dark Council}}</ref>, the chamber features 12 seats, not including the Emperor's throne, with 6 seats on each side.

==Gameplay alternatives==
If the player supported the Empire on [[Iokath]], then [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]] would chair the meeting of the Dark Council during the Onslaught expansion otherwise it would be chaired by [[Darth Vowrawn|Emperor Vowrawn]].<ref name="chamber_imp" />
